notes: Printed: 'Double strike. Vigilance. Trample.' The 1/1 Vindicator attacks and a 1/1 blocks it. First-strike damage: 1 to the blocker, which dies. Regular damage: the creature is still 'blocked' but its blocker is gone, and with trample it assigns all its damage to the player (CR 702.19e): the opponent goes 20 -> 19. Vigilance: it stays untapped.
